plan.title: Bidding on a Withdrawn Event Is Refused

steps.note: Open the prepared existing event under test.
Verify that the event is withdrawn before attempting the bid.
Switch to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the withdrawn event's pricing round as the vendor.
Attempt to submit a bid and require Procol to refuse it, proving no bid is created.
